purpose: Inventory of public surfaces. No public copy was rewritten or published. No registry version was mutated. No external account was changed. GitHub Support was not contacted.
disposition_note: Track 15 owns keep, rewrite, or remove. This track does not choose.
closed_actions: Rewrite or publish website copy, README copy, or release notes.
Mutate npm or PyPI, including yank, deprecate, or republish.
Dispatch or rerun the Python 3.1.0 publish workflow.
Change GitHub org settings, LinkedIn, X, or other external accounts.
Announce, issue credentials, or deploy to a customer.

method.website: HTTP GET of sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, security.txt, each sitemap URL, and a probe list of legacy, portal, API, and subdomain names. HTML parsed for title, meta, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter, JSON-LD types, forms, buttons, and anchors. Homepage nav and footer taken from nav and footer elements. Mobile check was one iPhone user-agent GET of /pricing.
method.github: GitHub REST for org vantioai, public member list, public repository list, contents, releases, tags, branches, and issue titles. Release asset bytes for custody-py-3.1.0 were downloaded and hashed. Named product repositories outside the public list were requested and recorded as HTTP 404, which does not distinguish missing from inaccessible.
method.npm: registry.npmjs.org search for vantio and maintainer vantioai, plus full registry documents for the four returned @vantio packages and HTTP probes of in-repo package names.
method.pypi: JSON API for vantio-agent-sdk latest and for 1.0.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0, 3.0.14, and 3.1.0. Name probes for other in-repo project names. The HTML search page did not return a project list.
method.other: HTTP and public page metadata for X, LinkedIn company URLs, Bluesky, YouTube, Crunchbase, Product Hunt, Wellfound, Open VSX, the Visual Studio Marketplace, Smithery, Glama, and the Cursor marketplace HTML. The official MCP registry host timed out. cursor.directory returned HTTP 429.
limits: No browser layout pass across breakpoints. Mobile evidence is the viewport meta tag plus one mobile user-agent response that matched the desktop document size.
Help-assistant, contact, and design-partner submission hosts were not present as form actions in static HTML.
Private repositories were not listed. This token's repository list for vantioai contained four public repositories.
Historical npm README bodies were not diffed version by version. Latest README plus version lists were read.
PyPI long descriptions were sampled at five versions, not all eighteen.
Code comments were not exhaustively quoted. A ripgrep of the starting checkout found 200 files containing the phrase Phantom Engine.

platform.note: The live site is a Next.js deployment on Vercel. It is not one of the four public vantioai repositories. vantio-open-core vercel.json only sets installCommand.

update_posts.title: Neural data is decoded on a Linux host. Who governs that pipeline? — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: Neural data is decoded on a Linux host. Who governs that pipeline?
update_posts.description: BCIs went commercial in 2026. The implant is not Vantio's work. The AI hosts that decode and move neural data are — and that pipeline can be governed without warehousing the signal.

update_posts.title: The humanoid's brain is a vision-language-action model. It runs on a host you own. — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: The humanoid's brain is a vision-language-action model. It runs on a host you own.
update_posts.description: Optimus, Figure, and Apollo are on real factory lines in 2026, driven by on-board vision-language-action models. Vantio protects that Linux brain — not the robot's balance or motion safety.

update_posts.title: Harvest now, decrypt later punishes data you keep. Vantio keeps less. — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: Harvest now, decrypt later punishes data you keep. Vantio keeps less.
update_posts.description: Vantio is not a quantum or cryptography company. The quantum threat still has a corollary most vendors skip: the data you never stored is the data no future machine can decrypt.

update_posts.title: When AI starts building AI, human review gets slower. The host does not. — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: When AI starts building AI, human review gets slower. The host does not.
update_posts.description: Recursive self-improvement is an active debate at the frontier labs. You do not need to believe a singularity is here to act on the implication: when review slows down, control on the host has to keep up.

update_posts.title: R155 treats your backend as part of the vehicle. Can you prove it's governed? — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: R155 treats your backend as part of the vehicle. Can you prove it's governed?
update_posts.description: UNECE R155 treats telematics and fleet servers as part of the vehicle attack surface. Those servers now run AI agents. Vantio helps you see and control them.

update_posts.title: CMMC protects your data. It was never scoped to govern your AI. — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: CMMC protects your data. It was never scoped to govern your AI.
update_posts.description: CMMC maps to NIST SP 800-171 and protects controlled data. It was never scoped to govern whether an AI model drifted or an agent went off-script. That gap is where defense autonomy sits.

update_posts.title: Part 108 opened the skies. Your companion computer is the new attack surface. — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: Part 108 opened the skies. Your companion computer is the new attack surface.
update_posts.description: A drone's intelligence rides on a small Linux computer. As Part 108 turns BVLOS into routine operations, that companion computer is the host you most need to see and protect.

update_posts.title: The FDA now judges your cyber plan before clearance. Your AI agents are in scope. — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: The FDA now judges your cyber plan before clearance. Your AI agents are in scope.
update_posts.description: As of February 2026, the FDA judges your cybersecurity plan before it clears your device. Medical robots run intelligence on hosts that touch PHI. Governing those hosts is now a premarket question.

update_posts.title: IEC 62443 doesn't cover your LLM agents yet. That gap is on the plant floor now. — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: IEC 62443 doesn't cover your LLM agents yet. That gap is on the plant floor now.
update_posts.description: Manufacturing hardened control systems for decades. IEC 62443 still does not fully address LLM agents. That gap lives on a Linux edge node — and that is where Vantio sits.

update_posts.title: A DDS injection shut a fulfillment center for 72 hours. The coordination server is the target. — Optics, Phantom Engine | Vantio
update_posts.h1: A DDS injection shut a fulfillment center for 72 hours. The coordination server is the target.
update_posts.description: Industry reporting in 2026 described a ROS 2 / DDS attack that halted a warehouse for 72 hours. The lever was coordination compute. That is what Vantio protects.

update_posts.description: The motors are well engineered. The AI planner on a Linux box, calling cloud models and moving data, is the part almost nobody is watching. Vantio protects that host.
